stem: Which statement best describes a result of industrialization in the United States during the mid-nineteenth century?

options.label: A
options.text: People moved to cities in search of economic opportunity.

options.label: B
options.text: Farmers began to cultivate land west of the Appalachian Mountains.

options.label: C
options.text: Native peoples were forcibly relocated to western territories.

options.label: D
options.text: Government officials began to promote the idea of Manifest Destiny.
